ohtani.title: Tarik Skubal spins seven scoreless in Dodgers' win
ohtani.blurb: Tarik Skubal shuts down the Giants with seven scoreless and 10 strikeouts as Pages and Hernandez homer in the Dodgers' 2-0 win over the Giants

imanaga.title: Griffin Conine hits go-ahead single in Marlins' win
imanaga.blurb: Griffin Conine hits a go-ahead single in the 12th inning and Kyle Stowers homers in the Marlins' 8-2 win over the Cubs

suzuki.title: Abreu's go-ahead double powers Red Sox' 2-0 win
suzuki.blurb: Wilyer Abreu lines the go-ahead double, plus Jedixson Paez throws five shutout innings as the Red Sox complete the doubleheader sweep

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Kazuma Okamoto's two RBI doubles lead Blue Jays' win
okamoto.blurb: Kazuma Okamoto laces two RBI doubles and Louis Varland earns his 35th save of the season in Blue Jays' 6-5 win over the Reds

murakami.title: Munetaka Murakami goes deep twice in 6-1 win
murakami.blurb: Munetaka Murakami notches his 3rd multi-homer game of the season and Kyle Teel drives in a pair to lead the White Sox to a 6-1 win over the Rockies

matsui.title: Padres clinch postseason berth with win over Dodgers
matsui.blurb: Mason Miller records the save as the Padres defeat the Dodgers to clinch a postseason berth for the third straight season
